knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Dizziness, headache and loss of sweating are signs of serious heat illness. Stop, cool and assess.
Trees and open structures do not protect from lightning. Move to a fully enclosed vehicle or building.
Do not disturb a nest. Mark, avoid and refer.
The heat, UV and work-rest planning section lists headache, dizziness, unusual tiredness, heavy sweating that stops, cramps, nausea and irritability as early signs.

practicalCriteria: Given a supplied weather scenario card, the learner states at least two continue, modify and stop conditions for the job within the assessor's set time.
The learner sets up a shade and water station for a supplied team and names the afternoon rest schedule.
The learner identifies a simulated wildlife hazard, marks a no-go zone and names the escalation contact without touching the hazard.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed weather trigger sheet signed by the assessor.
Assessor observation record of the shade, water and no-go set-up.
Escalation record showing the contact named.
stopWorkCriteria: Any approach to or disturbance of a simulated nest or animal.
Continuing outdoor work during a simulated lightning warning.
A simulated worker showing heat illness signs who is not stopped and cooled.
